messages.subject: Helpers needed for Software Carpentry Workshop
parts:
Hi all,

We are looking for a few helpers for the  Software Carpentry Workshop on June 16-17 (http://bernhardkonrad.github.io/2014-06-16-davis/).  The workshop is sold out, but we need a few helpful folk who can help people with computer issues and programming snafus. The workshop's topics are R, version control with git, and working with the command line, but expertise in these is not needed - helpers will most likely be answering very basic IT questions.

If you were thinking about attending but thought the workshop might be a little basic, volunteer and you can attend as a helper for free!

Please reply to Jonathan Cachat (cac...@gmail.com, @jcachat) and Benjamin Schwessinger (benjamin.s...@gmail.com, @schwessinger) if you are interested.

 - Noam
